setup.command: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .dotnet; if ! .dotnet/dotnet --list-sdks 2>/dev/null | grep -q "^10\."; then curl -fsSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh -o /tmp/dotnet-install.sh; bash /tmp/dotnet-install.sh --channel 10.0 --install-dir "$PWD/.dotnet" --no-path; fi; export PATH="$PWD/.dotnet:$PATH"; dotnet restore Agent.sln; npm install --prefix sample/web/frontend; npm run build --prefix sample/web/frontend'

check.command: bash -lc 'export PATH="$PWD/.dotnet:$PATH"; dotnet test Agent.sln --no-restore; npm run check --prefix sample/web/frontend'
